entry_id.rule: Immutable, assigned on entry, never reused

recorded_at.rule: When the row was entered, not when the period ended

campaign.rule: Must exist in campaigns; free text rejected

source_report.rule: Exact report name the figures came from

source_export_date.rule: A figure without an export date is rejected

tracking_id.rule: Must match the register tracking ID

eligible_sessions.rule: null = not reported; 0 = reported as zero. Never interchangeable

qualifying_revenue.rule: As defined by Amazon, net of the Commission Income Statement deductions

commission_income.rule: As reported. Never computed here from a rate

forbiddenFields.revenue_forecast: Prohibited by the project brief, and unsupported by Operating Agreement Section 4.

provenance.outcome: Committed with an empty entries array

provenance.event: Search for authorised first-party report data
provenance.outcome: None available. No Associates Central access in this session

provenance.event: Considered a third-party conversion estimate as a placeholder
provenance.outcome: Rejected. A placeholder estimate becomes indistinguishable from a real figure

note: Empty by design. Rows are added only from an authorised first-party report, with its name and export date recorded.
